_comment: The seasonal calendar for Stage 5. Temperatures are what SeasonManager hands the crop simulation, and crops.json already holds each crop's min_growth_temp_c - so a crop planted in a season below its minimum simply stops developing. That is the lesson, and it is data, not code.

seasons.teaching_note: Mild and damp. Good for leafy crops and beans; maize wants more heat than this.
seasons.warning: Spring is coming. Cabbage and beans do well now - hold maize back until summer.

seasons.teaching_note: Hot and dry. Everything grows fast, but the soil dries out fast too - water more often.
seasons.warning: Summer is coming. Maize thrives, but soil dries out half again as quickly. Plan to water more.

seasons.teaching_note: Cooling off. Cabbage still does well; maize slows to a crawl as the nights draw in.
seasons.warning: Autumn is coming. Cabbage is still safe. Maize planted now will not finish before the cold.

seasons.teaching_note: Too cold for anything in the seed box. Nothing sown now will develop - the ground is for resting.
seasons.warning: Winter is coming. Every crop you have is below its minimum growth temperature. Harvest what is standing before it arrives.
